AUTHORITY=NICOLAS
CONTROL_FRONT=SUPRA
MODE=EXECUTE_NOT_REINVESTIGATE
MISSION=INSTALL_SUPRA_PRIMARY_WORK_SURFACE_NOW

REQUIRED_PARENT=02f6584f26b3f6d65580279670ace6adc711110e

GOAL:
Nicolas works FROM SUPRA itself.
Do not use Nicolas as shell relay.
Do not create a new bridge/runtime/engine.

DO NOW:
1) Verify REQUIRED_APP_COMMIT is on canonical branch and CI SUCCESS.
2) Use the EXISTING updater/recovery channel only.
3) Install/update the canonical ~/Applications/SUPRA.app to a build containing REQUIRED_APP_COMMIT.
4) Preserve rollback.
5) Launch exactly one canonical SUPRA instance.
6) Prove the launched executable path is ~/Applications/SUPRA.app/Contents/MacOS/SUPRA.
7) Prove the default universe is SUPRA and the source contains the "Command SUPRA" primary work surface.
8) Do not require Nicolas to copy/paste Terminal commands.
9) Do not retire SUPRAClean unless separately proven safe.
10) Return a bounded receipt with installed source SHA, PID/path, build/launch proof, and whether the SUPRA work surface is ready.

NO_NEW_ENGINE=YES
NO_NEW_BRIDGE=YES
NO_NEW_RUNTIME=YES
NO_HUMAN_RELAY=YES
NO_BLIND_KILL=YES
PRESERVE_ROLLBACK=YES

STATUS=MATERIAL_RESULT_PROVEN|FAIL_BOUNDED|TRUE_HUMAN_GATE
INSTALLED_SOURCE_SHA=
SUPRA_PID=
SUPRA_EXEC=
